solutions.title: Preorder buffer and relink
solutions.strategy: Collect existing nodes in preorder, then relink them into a right-child-only chain and clear every left pointer.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is visited once during preorder collection and once during relinking.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The buffer stores references to all nodes before relinking.

solutions.title: In-place right-spine rewiring
solutions.strategy: For each node with a left subtree, splice that left subtree between the node and its original right subtree by attaching the old right subtree to the rightmost node of the left subtree.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is moved into the right spine once; walking to predecessor nodes is bounded by the total rewiring work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a few pointers are used while mutating the existing tree.
